title: Na Chenthanundumu – Yesaiah Neekosam Jeevista Telugu Christian Lyrics
intro: Na Chenthanundumu is one of the Old Telugu Christian song from the album, Yesaiah Neekosam Jeevista sung by Pastor K Subbarao. This song was translated from its Original Kannada song, Nan Hattiraviru O Yesuve is one of the best Kannada christian worship melody. The song was very beautifully composed and the lyrics are picked from bible which carry a lot of meaning. This song became so popular that it was translated into all south Indian languages.
